description: Add sidebar collapse state management with localStorage persistence and hamburger toggle button. Create a collapsed state (useState hook) in dashboard-shell.tsx initialized from localStorage key 'sidebar-collapsed'. Add hamburger/menu icon button in the header with aria-label 'Toggle sidebar' that toggles this state. On state change, persist to localStorage.
steps: In dashboard-shell.tsx, add useState hook for sidebar collapse state: const [sidebarCollapsed, setSidebarCollapsed] = useState(false)
Add useEffect to initialize sidebar state from localStorage on mount: read 'sidebar-collapsed' key and setSidebarCollapsed
Add useEffect to persist sidebar state to localStorage whenever sidebarCollapsed changes
Import Menu icon from lucide-react (or use existing icon)

Add hamburger button in the header before the workspace name div. Button should call setSidebarCollapsed(!sidebarCollapsed). Style: size-9 flex items-center justify-center rounded-md hover:bg-slate-100. Include aria-label='Toggle sidebar' for accessibility
Pass sidebarCollapsed state down to the sidebar element via className conditions (preparation for FEAT-002)
acceptance_criteria: Clicking the hamburger button toggles the sidebarCollapsed state
State persists across page reloads via localStorage
verification: Manual test: open dashboard, click toggle button, refresh page, verify state persists
findings: Successfully implemented sidebar collapse state management with localStorage persistence. The sidebarCollapsed state is now available in dashboard-shell.tsx and is passed to the sidebar element via className. The hamburger toggle button is positioned in the header before the workspace name and only displays on large screens (lg:flex). State persists across page reloads using the 'sidebar-collapsed' localStorage key. The sidebar element has the 'sidebar-collapsed' class applied when collapsed, ready for FEAT-002 to implement the visual collapse behavior.
